findings: Menu structure: Uzbek delivery menus (Wolt/Express24/Yandex Eats) group by dish type, not by course: national places use Osh/Palov, Birinchi taomlar (sho'rva, mastava, manpar, xash), Ikkinchi taomlar (lag'mon, manti, norin, qozon kabob, dimlama), Shashlik/Kabob, Somsa, Salatlar, Non, Ichimliklar; uyg'ur dishes (ganfan, guyru lag'mon, ayrimsay, go'shtsay, sokoro, sumboro) often have their own section. Fast-food chains: Lavash, Shaurma, Donar, Burger, Hot-dog, Sneklar (fri, naggets, strips), Kombo/Box, Souslar, Ichimliklar, Desertlar. Plov specialists sell almost only osh + salads + non + drinks. Units: most dishes are by portion; osh is sold as 0,5 / 0,7 / 1 porsiya, often as a 'komplekt' with qazi and bedana tuxumi, and by kg (and whole qozon) for events; tandir go'sht, mangal assorti, qanotlar and fried fish are often by kg or 0,5 kg; kabob is by 1 six (piece); manti and somsa by piece; some national places size by people (1 kishilik / 2 kishilik); tortlar by kg (1/1,5/2 kg) or whole, mini and bento by piece; chak-chak, holva, navvot, pechene by kg; choy by stakan or choynak. Sizes: lavash Mini / Standart / Katta (S/M/L at some chains), shaurma Mini / Standart; pizza 25 / 30 / 35 sm (kichik / o'rta / katta) with xamir choice (oddiy, yupqa, havodor, pishloqli bort, hot-dog bort); fri mini/standart/katta; naggets 4-18 dona, strips 3/5/7, qanotlar 3/5/8; coffee 0,2 / 0,3 / 0,4 l; quyma ichimlik 0,3 / 0,4 / 0,5 l; bottles 0,25 / 0,5 / 1 / 1,5 l; rolls 8 dona, sets 16-48 dona; non butun / yarimta / chorak. Add-ons: pishloq (most common), qo'shimcha go'sht, xalapeno, achchiq/sarimsoqli/pishloqli sous for fast food; qazi, bedana tuxumi, qo'shimcha go'sht, achchiq qalampir for osh; pizza toppings (qo'ziqorin, zaytun, kolbasa, ananas, tovuq, mol go'shti, bulg'or qalampiri); coffee syrups (karamel, vanil, yong'oq, kokos) and extra espresso; qaymoq/qatiq for manti and chuchvara. Combos: taom + fri + ichimlik (with a drink choice), 'box' sets, juftlik/2 kishilik, oilaviy set, kids box, lanch-boks, Ramazon iftorlik setlari; plov places sell 'osh + salat + non + ichimlik' combos. Packaging (paket, idish) is often a paid line. Spelling: real Uzbek-language menus write Kartoshka fri, Naggets, Pishloqli sous, Sarimsoqli sous, Xalapeno, Amerikano, Kapuchino, Pitsa, Lavash, Shaurma, Quyma (draft) drinks; many menus are Russian-first, so Russian-Latin spellings (plov, lagman, samsa, shashlik, shurpa, pelmeni) are kept as aliases. Brand drinks (Coca-Cola, Fanta, Chortoq) are kept as aliases of generic items.
